about.intro: I'm a *DevOps & Cloud Engineer* focused on building **high-availability, automated, and secure cloud infrastructure**.
about.description: I specialize in container orchestration with **Kubernetes**, enterprise-grade **AWS Landing Zones**, automated **CI/CD pipelines**, and cost-efficient **serverless architectures**.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Naveen S**. I build high-availability, automated, and secure cloud infrastructure. 

Specializing in container orchestration with **Kubernetes**, enterprise-grade **AWS Landing Zones**, automated **CI/CD pipelines**, and cost-efficient **serverless architectures**. Backed by clean Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.

projects.title: AI Interviewer Pro
projects.description: An advanced AI-powered interview platform featuring gaze tracking, real-time eye/emotion monitoring via MediaPipe Face Mesh, dynamic question generation, student dashboards, and automated PDF assessment reports.

projects.title: Automated Resume Relevance Check System
projects.description: An automated resume screening and ranking system that uses PyPDF2 and SentenceTransformers (NLP models) to measure semantic similarity between candidate resumes and job descriptions.

projects.title: Daily Tracker
projects.description: A lightweight daily activity tracking utility that enables users to log tasks, monitor progress, build habits, and optimize productivity over time.

projects.title: eBPF Threat Detection & Response Simulator
projects.description: An automated cloud-native security simulation platform leveraging eBPF-based Falco rules. Integrates Falco, Falcosidekick, and Falco Talon for active threat remediation (like automated pod termination), visualized via Prometheus and Grafana.

projects.title: Terraform Docker Container Orchestrator
projects.description: Infrastructure as Code setup utilizing Terraform's Docker provider to automate the lifecycle of containerized services, custom Docker networks, volumes, and multi-container environments.
